claim: For every \(q=2^e\) with \(e\ge1\) and \(M\ge1\), let \(A=\mathbb F_q[x]/(x^{2M})\). The complete rank generating polynomial of derivations \(D:A\to A\) with \(D^2=0\) is \[\mathcal R_{M,q}(z)=1+\sum_{r=1}^{M}(q-1)q^{r-1}z^r+\sum_{j=\lceil M/2\rceil}^{M-1}(q-1)q^{M-j-1}\left(q^{M-j}z^{M-j}+\sum_{\alpha=M-j}^{j-1}(q-1)q^{M-\alpha-1}z^{M-\alpha}\right).\] In particular \(\lvert\mathcal N_M\rvert=q^M+\lfloor M/2\rfloor(q-1)q^{M-1}\). For fixed \(q\), the normalized operator rank \(\operatorname{rank}(D)/M\) of a uniform square-zero derivation converges to \(\operatorname{Uniform}[1/2,1]\), with Wasserstein-1 error \(O_q(M^{-1})\).

integrity.computations: Executable direct matrix enumeration over F_2,F_4,F_8 in eleven cases and 237 symbolic totals; finite checks are not general proofs.
integrity.proof_method: Direct parity decomposition, valuation classification, exact finite-field counting and geometric-tail coupling.

scientific_limitations: Only \(\mathbb F_q[x]/(x^{2M})\) for \(q\) a power of two and \(M\ge1\); other field characteristics and odd truncations not included.
Only composition-square-zero derivations, not arbitrary nilpotent derivations or conjugacy orbits.
Asymptotic normalized-rank law fixes q and lets M increase.
Publication priority may be affected by older restricted-Witt or group-scheme calculations not located in inspected material.
title: Square-zero derivations of binary-characteristic truncated polynomial algebras: exact rank spectra and a uniform limit law
